description: Places de parking Personnes à mobilité réduite is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Nevers. All parking spaces reserved for PRM (People with Reduced Mobility) geolocated on the public road in the commune of Nevers. Coverage: Ville de Nevers. The portal shows the English title as "Parking spaces Persons with reduced mobility" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Nevers. Its keywords include pmr, places, parking. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ZIP, JSON. The listing shows 2018-01-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
